findings.finding: The P-ext Narrowing Clip instruction definitions do not exist in the OpenSBI firmware codebase. OpenSBI is M-mode firmware that does not need to define or emulate standard P-ext (Packed SIMD/DSP) instructions — these are handled directly by hardware. The referenced PR ("P-ext: add Narrowing Clip instruction definitions") likely targets the RISC-V ISA specification repository (riscv-isa-manual), not OpenSBI. No security concern arises from this absence; the absence is architecturally expected.
